commands.name: project-init
commands.description: Initialize a production/ workspace: project.yaml, directory layout, and phase plan.

commands.name: script-analyze
commands.description: Analyze a script for structure, beats, characters, locations, and production flags.

commands.name: story-bible
commands.description: Build or update the story bible: premise, themes, arcs, world rules, and timeline.

commands.name: character-bible
commands.description: Create character entries with identity anchors, wardrobe, and reference sheet plans.

commands.name: location-bible
commands.description: Create location entries with spatial maps, angles, lighting, and reference plans.

commands.name: prop-bible
commands.description: Catalog narrative props with visual specs, state tracking, and continuity notes.

commands.name: style-bible
commands.description: Define the visual language: palette, grain, lensing, grade intent, and style references.

commands.name: visual-development
commands.description: Run look development across characters, locations, and style into approved masters.

commands.name: scene-breakdown
commands.description: Break the script into scenes and beats with blocking, cast, and location assignments.

commands.name: shot-list
commands.description: Produce an ordered, schema-valid shot list with coverage, axes, and camera notes.

commands.name: smart-shot
commands.description: Orchestrate one scene end-to-end: shots, storyboard, reference plan, prompts, continuity.

commands.name: storyboard
commands.description: Generate storyboard frames and staging notes for a scene's shot list.

commands.name: reference-plan
commands.description: Select the reference images each shot's generation must use, within provider limits.

commands.name: generate-keyframes
commands.description: Compile prompts and generate keyframe images for shots via an image provider.

commands.name: generate-clips
commands.description: Compile prompts and generate video clips for shots via a video provider.

commands.name: continuity-review
commands.description: Audit scenes for axis, screen-direction, wardrobe, and prop continuity issues.

commands.name: edit-plan
commands.description: Assemble the edit plan: clip order, transitions, sound, music, and grade notes.

commands.name: full-production
commands.description: Run the entire pipeline from script to edit plan with approval gates between phases.

commands.name: humanize
commands.description: Rewrite any generated or existing prose so it reads human — no AI-writing tells — or audit it with --check.

commands.name: music-brief
commands.description: Set the music strategy in development — cues, tempo map, lyric sync points, licensing — before shot planning.
